prompts.name: encontro
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create one premium editorial photographic key visual for Pico Social, a Brazilian social app for sand sports. Portrait 4:5 composition, highest available resolution. Full-bleed warm butter #F2E3B5 and pale lavender #CBBBE0 organic pigment fields, very fine analog sand grain, like an exquisitely printed independent fashion campaign. The upper 40 percent is uninterrupted light butter/lavender negative space for dark typography to be added later. In the lower 60 percent, a candid intimate photograph of three adult Brazilian recreational beach-tennis players (a dark-skinned woman with natural curls, a tan man, and a woman with dark hair), chatting and smiling naturally after playing on sand, seen waist-up, one correctly shaped perforated beach-tennis paddle partly visible. Cream, muted lavender, cocoa sportswear. Not posed to camera, not fitness advertising; real human interaction. Natural softly warm late-afternoon lighting, realistic skin. The photograph melts softly at its upper perimeter into the tactile airy pigment field, no rectangular photo card, no hard montage edge. Preserve photo clarity on faces; grain is mainly in the atmospheric color fields. The players' heads begin below 43% of the image. No text, letters, typography, logo, watermarks, mobile phone, UI, extra objects, green, orange or electric blue. Image should feel minimal, artistic, warm and editorial, with generous negative space.

prompts.name: equipamento
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. One luxury editorial still-life key visual for the Brazilian sand-sports social app Pico. Portrait 4:5, high resolution. Full-bleed tactile warm butter #F2E3B5 and soft pale lavender #CBBBE0 background, grainy organic color fields that dissolve into actual fine beach sand in the bottom half, analog fine pigment grain, quiet fashion art direction. The upper 48 percent must be sparse uninterrupted LIGHT butter/paper/lavender negative space for a short dark headline added later. In the bottom half, carefully art-directed realistic objects: one cocoa-and-cream perforated beach-tennis paddle resting diagonally on sand and one cream volleyball with muted lavender panels beside it, realistic proportions, subtle footprints and elegant soft diagonal shadows. Shot from directly above, asymmetric arrangement with the paddle extending diagonally across the lower part and ball at lower right. A tiny restrained muted orange tennis ball may sit close to the paddle but no additional objects. Natural diffused late-afternoon light. Sophisticated material detail, believable woven paddle grip and real sand, no glossy plastic 3D render. No text, logo, label, UI, watermark or frame. The real sand smoothly transitions into broad abstract pigment color fields without a visible seam.

prompts.name: memoria
prompts.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Produce a striking minimal editorial photograph for Pico Social, a Brazilian sand-sports app campaign about the memory left after a game. Portrait 4:5, high resolution. Broad flowing butter #F2E3B5 and very pale lavender #CBBBE0 color fields with fine sand-like analog pigment grain. Upper 46 percent of the image is empty, airy LIGHT butter/paper negative space for a cocoa headline added later. Lower half: close-up of a single anatomically realistic adult tan hand and wrist entering naturally from the right edge, letting a thin stream of beach sand slip loosely between fingers toward the ground below; warm tactile sand, a gentle curve in the relaxed fingers, tiny falling grains catch soft late-afternoon light. No jewelry and no extra hands. The gesture is quiet and human, not mystical; subject occupies only the lower right half, leaving breathing room. The surrounding photographic sand dissolves gently into the smooth lavender/butter grainy fields, no photo border or hard montage seam. Skin color realistic, no purple skin. Palette restrained and matte, fine texture, premium print campaign art direction. No text, letters, logo, watermarks, phone, UI, oversized dunes, orange, neon, green or blue.
